Claims Handling Runbook

The nightly batch runs at 02:00 UTC. This document is the operational record; the policy it implements lives in the benefits handbook.

Escalation table

Severity

Who to call

Within

Batch failed twice

Claims platform on-call

15 minutes

Payment file rejected

Treasury, then claims platform

1 hour

Member data exposed

Security duty officer, always

Immediately

Re-running the batch

Re-runs are idempotent per claim id, so a partial night is safe to repeat:

claims-batch --date 2026-03-14 --resume --dry-run

Check the output, then run it again without --dry-run.

What not to do

  • Never edit claim rows by hand; the batch keeps its own audit trail
  • Never re-point the batch at production from a laptop
